protocol.name: bead_layer_motion_v1
protocol.description: Defines a set of rectangular presentation planes sampling one layer surface buffer. A compositor animates the planes at output presentation rate without requiring client commits for each animation frame.

description.summary: Create presentation controllers for layer surfaces

entry.name: duplicate_controller
entry.summary: Surface already has a motion controller

request.name: get_motion

description.summary: Create a controller for a layer surface

request.description: The surface must already have a layer-shell role. The client should create the controller and its planes in the same commit that attaches the first complete buffer.

interface.name: bead_layer_motion_v1

description.summary: Group animation of atlas presentation planes

interface.description: Plane requests are double-buffered with the associated wl_surface state. The animate request starts one shared timeline for all configured planes on the next predicted presentation following the commit. Source rectangles use the logical surface texture after buffer transform and viewport mapping. Destination rectangles and clips use logical surface-local units. Clips are fixed in the unanimated surface frame and applied after the destination rectangle is placed. Planes are composited in creation order: the first plane is backmost and each later plane appears above earlier ones.

description.summary: Normalized easing function applied to all planes

entry.name: opaque_above
entry.summary: Use full opacity above the configured threshold

description.summary: Destroy controller and cancel any active animation

request.name: add_plane

description.summary: Add a source rectangle and initial presentation state

request.description: The source is immutable for the plane lifetime. All coordinates and extents are logical fixed-point values. Extents must be non-negative.

description.summary: Set the target presentation state of one plane
Set the starting state used by the next animation

request.name: animate

description.summary: Start one synchronized animation for all planes

request.description: Requests take effect atomically on the next wl_surface.commit. A nonzero retarget samples every plane's current presentation and ignores the from states supplied with add_plane. A zero retarget uses those from states. Replacing an active animation cancels its serial first.

description.summary: Freeze the active animation at its current state

request.name: reset

description.summary: Clear compositor presentation state at the next surface commit

request.description: The compositor samples and cancels any active animation, then removes all configured planes and presentation transforms for the associated surface. Pending plane, animation, or cancel requests queued before reset are discarded. The reset becomes visible atomically with the next wl_surface.commit, which may attach ordinary replacement content. Cancellation events for the active serial are sent after that commit. The staged curve returns to linear; requests queued after reset may define a new plane set for the same commit. The controller remains usable, and serial monotonicity is preserved.

event.name: plane_state

description.summary: Final committed state of one plane

event.description: Sent once for every plane before done or cancelled.
